description: Chocolate4U Iran-v2ray-rules: geo files for Xray and V2Ray tuned for Iran (geoip:ir, geosite:ir, Persian ads), with malware, phishing and cryptominer block lists and lite and MaxMind (.mmdb) variants, rebuilt daily. 3X-UI's geoip_IR.dat and geosite_IR.dat.
notes: Data only, no program. The 'Chocolate4U Iran-v2ray-rules' shortcut in Scoop Apps lists the files.
Upstream releases every day at about 04:40 UTC; 'scoop update Chocolate4U-Iran-v2ray-rules' fetches them.
gesu/3X-UI copies geoip.dat and geosite.dat into its bin folder as geoip_IR.dat and geosite_IR.dat each time it starts.
Xray reads the files from XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET, e.g. %USERPROFILE%\scoop\apps\Chocolate4U-Iran-v2ray-rules\current.
Built from MaxMind GeoLite2 (https://www.maxmind.com) and IP2Location LITE (https://lite.ip2location.com) data, CC BY-SA 4.0.

script: # Data only: the shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which lists the files.
$lines = @(
'@ECHO OFF',
':: Chocolate4U Iran-v2ray-rules: shows what the package holds and where, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO Chocolate4U Iran-v2ray-rules: routing rules for Xray and V2Ray from',
'ECHO github.com/Chocolate4U/Iran-v2ray-rules, rebuilt every day; Scoop updates them.',
'ECHO.',
('ECHO Release: ' + $version + ' (tag on GitHub, UTC date and time)'),
'ECHO Folder:  %~dp0',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO V2Ray / Xray format (.dat):',
'ECHO   geoip.dat           every country; ir with Iranian CDNs and messengers, cloudflare,',
'ECHO                       google, amazon, microsoft, malware, phishing...',
'ECHO   geosite.dat         ir, category-ir, category-ads-all, malware, phishing,',
'ECHO                       cryptominers, sanctioned and all v2fly lists',
'ECHO   geoip-lite.dat      only ir and private',
'ECHO   geosite-lite.dat    only ir, category-ir and ads',
'ECHO   geoip-services.dat  only the CDN and service ranges',
'ECHO   security.dat        geosite: category-ads-all, malware, phishing, cryptominers',
'ECHO   security-ip.dat     geoip: malware, phishing',
'ECHO MaxMind format (.mmdb): Country, Country-lite, Services and Security-ip,',
'ECHO the same lists as geoip, geoip-lite, geoip-services and security-ip.',
'ECHO.',
'ECHO gesu/3X-UI copies geoip.dat and geosite.dat into its bin folder as',
'ECHO geoip_IR.dat and geosite_IR.dat each time it starts.',
'ECHO.',
'PAUSE',
[IO.File]::WriteAllText("$dir\Chocolate4U-Iran-v2ray-rules.cmd", ($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
